title: Assemblies and metadata in one screen
rememberThis: Assembly = IL + metadata + manifest — versioned unit, not one file per type.
Attributes are metadata; frameworks read them at run time or compile time via generators.
Reflection is for startup discovery — not per-request hot paths.
Public API CI blocks accidental breaking changes in shared libraries.
bullets: InternalsVisibleTo exposes internals to test assemblies without public surface bloat.
JsonSerializerContext and LibraryImport are source-generated — trim and Native AOT friendly.
Default new types to internal; public is a publishing decision.
ApiCompat and PublicApiAnalyzers diff exported surface on every pull request.
